LAREDO, Texas — Ever Aguilar-Lopez was arrested Wednesday morning, October 21, 2026, at 9:48 a.m. and booked into the Webb County Jail the same day on an alleged third-degree felony charge of injury to a child, elderly person, or disabled person with intent to cause bodily injury, according to Webb County booking records.

Bond was set at $10,000 on the charge. The booking record listed the city as Laredo, TX 78041; the arresting agency was not listed.

A third-degree felony in Texas is punishable by two to 10 years in prison and a fine of up to $10,000.

An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction. Ever Aguilar-Lopez is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.

— Walter Webb & Willa Webb, News Anchors, Webb Watch 956
